purpose: Provide the only machine-readable authorization consumed by the Stage2/Stage3 harnesses. This document may be emitted only after the final canonical Stage1 source and native evidence are frozen.

evidence.native_source_coverage_report: <path + SHA tied to final canonical source>

all measured capacities pass without truncation
parameter and local metadata native qualification
mutable locals modeled as storage identities with explicit LOAD/STORE semantics
fixed-array element access modeled with explicit storage identity + semantic index operand; physical generic LOAD/STORE is allowed
verifier v2 rejects malformed def-use/storage/CFG fixtures
general emitter consumes verified IR only
Stage1 compiles the exact final canonical compiler source into a real compiler artifact
prohibited: creating the gate from static projections alone
creating the gate before native self-emit
using raw-source codegen or Python compiler delegation to satisfy self-emit
reusing the gate after canonical source bytes change
treating a storage identity as a scalar semantic value without an explicit load
treating a fixed-array element as a scalar value without an explicit semantic index operand
